narrative.overview: Use the official Zeus UI design system selected by the user at myzeusui.com: white canvas, neutral panels, Inter typography, blue actions, and a floating icon sidebar. Poker remains the content. The immersive 3D lounge uses the same action language in transparent widgets over its night scene.
keyCharacteristics: One account appearance, with no light, dark, or cyber selector.
Compact navigation that expands to show names and real tables.
Actual account data, honest empty states, readable gains and losses.
A full viewport for the 3D world, independent of the control state.
dos: Do use the installed Zeus SDK and tokens for shared application controls.
Do preserve native forms and all existing poker actions during visual changes.
Do show real account data and readable negative chart values.
Do keep the world canvas stable when controls appear, collapse, or hide.
donts: Don't restore old theme selectors or global cyber overrides.
Don't let UI typing steer the character.
Don't put scenery or HUD labels across the overhead card area.
